description_en: Queries the performance metrics of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询实例性能数据
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-db-instance-performance --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --key MySQL_NetworkTraffic --start-time 2012-06-08T15:00Z --end-time 2012-06-18T15:00Z --node-id 3390000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBInstancePerformance

parameters.description_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.
parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.description_en:
The performance metrics that you want to query. Separate multiple values with commas (,). You can specify up to 30 values. For more information, see [Performance parameters](~~26316~~).

> If you set **Key** to **MySQL\_SpaceUsage** or **SQLServer\_SpaceUsage**, you can query the monitoring data within only one day.
parameters.description_zh:
想要查询的性能指标，多个值用半角逗号（,）分隔，最多传入30个。详细参数请参见[性能参数表](~~26316~~)。
>**Key**为**MySQL_SpaceUsage**或**SQLServer_SpaceUsage**时，仅支持查询1天内的监控数据。

parameters.name: key

parameters.description_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

> The time span between the beginning time and the end time must be longer than the monitoring frequency. Otherwise, this operation may return an empty array.
parameters.description_zh: 查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 >开始和结束时间间隔需要大于您实例的监控频率，否则可能返回空列表。
